_note: Scaled-down algorithmic reproduction of REASON Sec. IV / Table IV. The paper evaluates full neuro-symbolic systems on ten real datasets; this gym evaluates the same three kernel families (CNF logic, HMM, probabilistic circuit) on generated instances, scoring each method's procedure on hidden instances. Paper numbers are kept unchanged: where they are not on the gym's scale they sit under keys starting with '_' (see each experiment). Retention metrics are 100*exp(mean change in held-out log-likelihood) of the transformed model vs the original model (per sample for PCs, per token for HMMs) at an evaluator-fixed memory budget; memory = nodes + edges of the two-input-regularised DAG compiled by the evaluator.

sat_implication_pruning.description: Logical reasoning graph compression: the transformed CNF must have exactly the same models as the input (certified by the evaluator); score is the memory reduction of its two-input DAG, averaged over hidden instances.

memory_reduction_pct.description: 100*(M_in - M_out)/M_in with M = nodes+edges of the evaluator-compiled, two-input-regularised CNF DAG (literal leaves, clause OR nodes, formula AND). Clipped to [0,100] per instance. Requires logical equivalence; a non-equivalent or uncertifiable output fails the run.

sat_implication_pruning._paper_note: reason_algorithm.memory_reduction_pct = 21 is the paper's AlphaGeometry/MiniF2F memory reduction (same quantity, different workload; the paper's logical workloads span 21-38%).

hmm_flow_pruning.description: Sequential probabilistic reasoning graph compression: the transformed HMM must fit each evaluator-fixed memory budget (40/30/20% of the original's two-input DAG memory); score is held-out per-token likelihood retention on the deployment task at each budget, averaged over hidden instances.

ll_retention_pct_mem40.description: 100*exp(mean over held-out task sequences of [log p_out(x) - log p_in(x)] / T) for the model submitted under the 40% memory budget. Can exceed 100. Per-sequence change floored at -30 nats.

hmm_flow_pruning._paper_note: reason_algorithm.ll_retention_pct_mem40 = 98.8506 is the paper's task-performance ratio 86/87 (Ctrl-G, CoAuthor) at the paper's own 29% memory reduction. It is not the same quantity (task success vs likelihood) nor the same operating point (the gym's first budget removes 60% of memory); it is recorded only because the schema requires a proposed value.

pc_flow_pruning.description: Probabilistic-circuit graph compression: the transformed circuit must be a valid (smooth, decomposable, normalised) circuit over the same variables that fits each evaluator-fixed memory budget (20/15/12% of the original's two-input DAG memory); score is held-out per-sample likelihood retention on the deployment task at each budget, averaged over hidden instances.

ll_retention_pct_mem20.description: 100*exp(mean over held-out task samples of [log p_out(x) - log p_in(x)]) for the circuit submitted under the 20% memory budget. Can exceed 100. Per-sample change floored at -20 nats.

pc_flow_pruning._paper_note: reason_algorithm.ll_retention_pct_mem20 = 99.2084 is the paper's AUPRC ratio 0.752/0.758 (R2-Guard, TwinSafety) at the paper's own 37% memory reduction; not the same quantity or operating point, recorded only because the schema requires a proposed value.
